google.title: Google sign-in
google.description: Sign in with your Google account instead of typing your password. It takes three steps and about five minutes, and your password keeps working.
google.linked: Google is linked to your owner account.
google.error: Google sign-in could not finish. Only the Google account linked in your settings can sign in. Try again or use your password.
google.settings.hint: Import the JSON file you downloaded or paste the Client ID and Client Secret. Blogram checks them with Google and applies them right away, with no restart.
google.settings.enableHint: When off, the Google button is hidden and Google sign-in is rejected.
google.settings.secretSaved: A secret is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
google.settings.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the URI and copy it manually.
google.settings.managedByEnv: Google sign-in is managed by the GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. Remove both to manage it here.
google.settings.errors.invalid: These settings are not valid. Enabling needs a Client ID and a Client Secret, and changing the Client ID needs a new secret.
google.settings.errors.managed: Google sign-in is managed by the environment and cannot be changed here.
google.settings.errors.generic: Google settings could not be saved. Try again.
google.linkUnavailable: Save the credentials in step 2 first.
google.guide.intro: Google has to know this site before it lets you sign in. Do this once, in a new tab:
google.guide.project: Open Google Auth Platform, create a project if it asks, and fill in an app name and your support email.
google.guide.audience: In Audience, choose External and add your Gmail address as a test user.
google.guide.client: In Clients, create a client of type Web application and paste these two values:
google.guide.download: Create the client, then download its JSON file or copy the Client ID and Client Secret into step 2.
google.settings.imported: Credentials imported. Save to turn on Google sign-in.
google.settings.importInvalid: That is not a Google OAuth client JSON file.
google.settings.importWrongType: That JSON belongs to a desktop client. Create a client of type Web application.
google.settings.redirectMissing: That client does not list this site's redirect URI yet. Add it in Google Cloud or sign-in will fail.
google.settings.clientIdInvalid: This does not look like a Google web Client ID. It must end in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
google.settings.errors.invalidClient: Google does not recognise this Client ID and Secret. Check that you copied both completely, from the same client.
google.reauth.title: Confirm your password
google.reauth.hint: For your security, Google can only be linked or unlinked right after you confirm your password.
